physics_configuration.engine: torchfdtd.Simulation, 2D (x propagation, y periodic or Bloch, z invariant), staircase Yee material sampling (material_sampling=yee), courant_factor 0.99, precision float64 on CPU

domain_um.pml: 0.5 um at both x ends rounded to whole coarse cells (see slabs)
domain_um.y: 6 coarse cells, periodic (normal incidence) or Bloch (oblique)

physics_configuration.mesh_definition: h = d / (2 round(20 d n / 1.55 um)), i.e. the N40 mesh of G3-02_dielectric_slab_tmm: about 40 cells per material wavelength at 1.55 um (39.9 to 41.3) for every index; the slab is an integer number of cells and its faces sit 1/4 cell off the sample planes (the coarse 1/8 cell offset). The 20-cell mesh (h = d / round(20 d n / 1.55 um)) is still run and recorded for the energy balance and the convergence order, without an R/T or phase limit.

source.note: three-cycle Gaussian at 193.4 THz with the C1 endpoint taper; a fixed-k_parallel sheet at 45 deg is grazing beyond 1.55/sin(45 deg) = 2.19 um, where three cycles leave 2.5e-7 of the peak amplitude (one cycle would leave 17 percent and a non-decaying grazing residual); amplitude 1; soft sheet

monitors.TM: Hz at the sample x+h/2, y=h/2

physics_configuration.angle_definition: fixed k_parallel = (2 pi / 1.55 um) sin(theta) set through the Bloch phase k_parallel * L_y; the sheet is a fixed-k_parallel broadband source, not a fixed-angle one, so the angle varies across the band as sin theta(f) = k_parallel c / (2 pi f): 20 deg -> 16.7 to 23.4 deg, 45 deg -> 36.4 to 55.2 deg over 1.3 to 1.8 um; the oracle uses the same k_parallel at every frequency
physics_configuration.reference_run: identical scene without the slab; r = (S_slab - S_empty)/S_empty at the reflection monitor, t = S_slab/S_empty at the transmission monitor, S the +f DFT of the raw trace
physics_configuration.propagation_corrections: r is referred to the physical front face with exp(-2 i kx (x_face - x_monitor)) and t to the pair of faces with exp(+i kx d), kx the discrete vacuum Yee wavenumber at (omega, k_parallel); the continuum-corrected values are recorded as well

frequencies.spacing: uniform in frequency from c/1.8 um to c/1.3 um

mesh_sweep: N20 (energy balance and convergence order only)

layer_A.description: n=1.5, d=0.2 um, 45 deg, TE and TM, N20 rerun on CUDA FP32 (complex64 Bloch fields, CUDA graph); raw traces / FP64 peak compared to CPU FP64

reference_method: transfer matrix from Fresnel coefficients written in the test: q = kx (TE) or kx/eps (TM), r12 = (q1-q2)/(q1+q2), t12 = 2 q1/(q1+q2), r = (r12 + r23 e^{2 i beta})/(1 + r12 r23 e^{2 i beta}), t = t12 t23 e^{i beta}/(1 + r12 r23 e^{2 i beta}), beta = kx2 d, kx_j = sqrt(eps_j k0^2 - k_parallel^2); R = |r|^2, T = |t|^2; no solver code

observables.name: balance_residual
observables.definition: max over the band of | R_fdtd + T_fdtd - 1 |

observables.name: t_phase_error
observables.definition: max over the band where |t_tmm| > 0.1 of |arg(t_fdtd / t_tmm)| (Yee-corrected)

observables.name: r_phase_error
observables.definition: max over the band where |r_tmm| > 0.1 of |arg(r_fdtd / r_tmm)|; reported only (reference-plane ambiguity of the staircase face)

observables.name: layer_A_trace_error
observables.definition: CUDA FP32 trace / FP64 peak against CPU FP64 trace / FP64 peak

observables.name: convergence_order_ratio
observables.definition: max |dR| and max t phase error at the 20-cell mesh divided by the same quantity at the 40-cell mesh, per (slab, angle, polarization)

N40.t_phase_band: every band frequency where |t_tmm| > 0.1 (all of them for these lossless slabs)

convergence_order.applies_to: max |dR| and max t phase error, 20-cell over 40-cell, every (slab, angle, polarization)
convergence_order.note: second-order convergence gives 4; the band keeps the dispersion finding as a test

acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: completion_gates.json proposed_thresholds slab_R_T_absolute_error, lossless_complete_channel_balance_absolute_error, phase_error_radians_on_predeclared_supported_signal_band, discrete_dimensionless_fp32; the convergence-order band is this case's own pre-declared budget

applicable_scope: revision 2 of G3-02: layer B physics (CPU FP64, 2D staircase Yee sampling, n=1.5 and 3.5, 0.2 and 0.5 um, 0/20/45 deg fixed k_parallel, TE and TM) with the R/T/phase limits at about 40 cells per material wavelength, the 20-cell mesh recorded with the energy-balance limit and the 20-over-40 convergence-order test, and layer A (CUDA FP32 complex64 Bloch fields with CUDA graph on the RTX 3060 against CPU FP64, n=1.5 0.2 um 45 deg TE and TM); the first case's FAILED evidence run 20260921T164814Z-g3-02-1e349534 stays on record as the resolution finding
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent
